subject: Bluehaven evaluation — competitive scorecard, onboarding lift, and packaging tradeoffs
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@bluehaven.ai>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluating alternatives — need a comparative view and onboarding lift

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking a look. Our evaluation committee asked for a compact comparison of economics and the expected onboarding effort if we were to move from our incumbent (EdgeServe) to Redwood. Specifically:

- Side-by-side unit economics for our current footprint (p50 token mix)
- Any upfront credits or run-rate concessions you can offer for a pilot + 6-month ramp
- Estimated engineering onboarding lift (person-weeks) and key integration gaps (auth, KMS, routing)

Can you send a short scorecard and an initial number for onboarding lift? Procurement (cc'd) will want to see vendor evidence (SOC2) and a contract timeline.

Best,
Emily Park
Head of Platform
Bluehaven

Attachments: None

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@bluehaven.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluating alternatives — need a comparative view and onboarding lift

Emily —

Thanks, and great to connect. I've attached a concise scorecard (redwood-scorecard-v1.xlsx) that maps your current usage profile against our pricing and estimated per-token cost under two packaging options (pay-as-you-go and 12mo commitment). Also attached is an onboarding-lift-estimate.pdf with our best estimate for engineering effort and a short checklist of integration workstreams (auth/KMS, model pinning, routing fallbacks).

High level:
- p50 estimated token cost: ~18% lower on run-rate with a 12mo commitment; pay-as-you-go is closer to parity but still cheaper on p95 latency-sensitive endpoints because of batching and KV-cache benefits.
- Pilot credits: we can offer a pilot credit pool (USD 60k) tied to a 90-day pilot and a performance milestone.
- Onboarding lift: we estimate 4–6 person-weeks for core integration (auth, deployment, smoke tests); a deeper runtime optimization phase (quantization/ops tuning) is an additional 3–5 person-weeks if you need max cost reduction.

Next steps: Marissa on commercial ops will outline packaging options and an initial commercial anchor. Jonas is looped for escalation on special concessions. If procurement can share the contract timing, we can align the credit structure and DocuSign timeline.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: redwood-scorecard-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), onboarding-lift-estimate.pdf (pdf)

2) How do you model egress/eggs on embeddings-heavy endpoints — we expect a prolonged embeddings workload for search.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Evaluating alternatives — need a comparative view and onboarding lift

Aaron —

Answering your questions and adding the commercial packaging options we discussed internally:

1) The 18% assumes your provided distribution (avg ~512 tokens) with KV cache enabled on latency-sensitive routes; the spreadsheet has a p50/p90/p95 split. If you disable KV cache for some endpoints, delta compresses to ~10–12%.

2) For embeddings-heavy workload we modeled an embeddings unit (per 1k vectors) line item. Embeddings egress was charged as standard egress in the model; if you expect >10TB/mo we recommend an embeddings-bucketed SKU which reduces unit egress by ~25% after the threshold.

Commercial options (initial anchors):
- Option A: Pilot (90d) — USD 60k credit + pay-as-you-go for production. No term commitment.
- Option B: 12mo Commitment — 18% run-rate reduction vs incumbent at target volumes; includes 3mo onboarding credit (applied as bill credit) and priority onboarding support.
- Option C: Enterprise Bundle — 12mo commit + 20% initial credit (applied upfront) + optional extended retention (audit log retention 12 mo) at fixed fee.

We can also set a staged rollback clause (30–60d) if perf regressions occur during the pilot. HubSpot deal link below has the initial numeric anchors.

Related: soc2 attestation and audit logs are attached (soc2-attestation-2025.pdf). I also attached a sample DocuSign with commercial anchors and a redlines attachment for your team to annotate (bluehaven-redlines-docusign.pdf).

If procurement can confirm timeline (target signature by 2026-08-12), we will hold the Pilot credit and schedule the onboarding slots.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: soc2-attestation-2025.pdf, bluehaven-redlines-docusign.pdf

- Please confirm data residency options and whether the optional extended retention in Option C can be scoped to EU customers only (we have a small EU subset).

Also: please provide a short implementation runbook for the 4–6 person-week onboarding window so we can budget internal engineering resources.
